issue: Psych-predicate: 아이들이 (3rd-person experiencer) + bare adjective 기뻐요 is nonstandard. Emotion adjectives (기쁘다/슬프다/무섭다) describe the speaker's own feeling; a 3rd-person subject's visible emotion takes the -아/어하다 verb: 기뻐해요. Heard colloquially, but prescriptively wrong for a teaching deck.

fix.grammar: 3rd-person feelings take -어하다: 아이들이 기뻐해요 (gippeohaeyo = they're happy).

issue: Psych-predicate: 온 가족이 (3rd-person experiencer) + bare 기뻐요 is nonstandard. A 3rd-person subject's emotion should use the -어하다 verb 기뻐해요, not the plain adjective. Same issue as ko-1814.

fix.target: 아기가 첫돌을 맞아서 온 가족이 기뻐해요.
fix.grammar: 3rd-person feelings take -어하다: 온 가족이 기뻐해요 (gippeohaeyo = the family is happy).
